actions.action: Separate quote verification from imported speaker labels
actions.mechanism: Track text, timing, and attribution verification separately; imported labels never establish speaker identity.
actions.implementation: Default to unverified. Require recorded reviewer confirmation for each dimension before marking a quote verified; allow speaker identity to remain unknown.
actions.check: Import an incorrect label and export an unresolved-speaker quote. Neither may display verified attribution, including in plain-text exports.
actions.risk: A single overall badge could conceal unresolved dimensions.

actions.action: Propagate corrections through versioned quote references
actions.mechanism: Append-only revisions update current collections while preserving their original saved versions and imported text.
actions.implementation: Store corrections with segment IDs, parent revision, reviewer identity, and changed fields. Collections retain saved revision references and resolve current revisions separately.
actions.check: Correct a speaker after saving two collections. Both show the correction; their original versions and reviewer audit trail remain accessible.
actions.risk: Silent updates could obscure changes; display revision differences.

actions.action: Export quotes as explicit audio-backed spans
actions.mechanism: Quote spans cross segment boundaries without assuming that either segment's speaker or timestamps are correct.
actions.implementation: Store ordered segment IDs, selected text ranges, audio asset ID, and reviewed playback intervals. Export these with revision identifiers and playable links.
actions.check: Export a quote crossing two segments with different labels and an unresolved speaker. Links must play every selected portion without asserting one speaker.
actions.risk: Expired links break traceability; retain durable asset identifiers.

actions.action: Provide contextual listening and timestamp repair
actions.mechanism: Listening beyond imported boundaries lets reviewers inspect speaker transitions and locate clipped or misplaced words.
actions.implementation: Add expandable before-and-after playback and draggable quote boundaries. Save interval repairs as reviewer-attributed revisions; invalidate affected timing verification pending recheck.
actions.check: Seed a timestamp offset that excludes the sentence opening. A reviewer must recover it, save the interval, and replay the corrected export.
actions.risk: Context can inform attribution but cannot guarantee speaker identity.
